origin.description: Evaluate f on a grid and draw a colored surface.
origin.usage: ezsurf(fn, xlim=c(-pi, pi), ylim=c(-pi, pi), n=60)
origin.details: x + y on a 4 by 4 grid. R time is that matrix, not a graphics device.
origin.value: Evaluate f on a grid and draw a colored surface.
origin.example: { xx <- linspace(-1, 1, 4); yy <- linspace(-1, 1, 4); F <- matrix(NA, 4, 4); for (i in 1:4) for (j in 1:4) F[i,j] <- xx[i]+yy[j]; pdf(file.path(tempdir(),"p.pdf")); ezsurf(function(v) v[1]+v[2], c(-1,1), c(-1,1), n=4); dev.off(); as.numeric(F) }
